items.zh: 存下第一笔一万元。
items.en: Save the first ten thousand.

items.zh: 换一台跟得上我的电脑。
items.en: A laptop that keeps up with me.

items.zh: 给家里换一张睡得好的床。
items.en: A bed the whole family can sleep well in.

items.zh: 把那台一直想买的相机带回家。
items.en: Bring home the camera I keep borrowing.

items.zh: 修好小时候那辆自行车。
items.en: Fix the bike from my childhood.

items.zh: 买一件能穿十年的大衣。
items.en: A coat I will still wear in ten years.

items.zh: 有一张只放自己东西的书桌。
items.en: A desk that holds only my things.

items.zh: 把租来的房间住成家。
items.en: Turn a rented room into a home.

items.zh: 存够一台咖啡机的钱。
items.en: Save up for the coffee machine.

items.zh: 给爸妈换一台新冰箱。
items.en: A new fridge for my parents.

items.zh: 去看一次海，不拍照也可以。
items.en: See the sea, even without photos.

items.zh: 坐一次通宵的火车。
items.en: Take one overnight train.

items.zh: 在演唱会里跟着唱一整首。
items.en: Sing a whole song at a concert.

items.zh: 一个人去看一场电影。
items.en: Go to a film alone.

items.zh: 去一座没去过的城市住两天。
items.en: Two days in a city I have never seen.

items.zh: 在陌生的地方待满一个月。
items.en: Live somewhere unfamiliar for a month.

items.zh: 学做一道能端上桌的菜。
items.en: Cook one dish worth putting on the table.

items.zh: 看一次日出，从黑等到亮。
items.en: Wait for one sunrise, from dark to light.

items.zh: 在美术馆待一整个下午。
items.en: Spend a whole afternoon in a museum.

items.zh: 带自己去吃一顿贵的。
items.en: Take myself to one expensive dinner.

items.zh: 学一门能换钱的手艺。
items.en: Learn a craft someone will pay for.

items.zh: 考下那张一直拖着的证。
items.en: Pass the certificate I keep postponing.

items.zh: 读完十二本书。
items.en: Read twelve books.

items.zh: 把英语捡回来。
items.en: Pick my English back up.

items.zh: 学会剪一条自己的视频。
items.en: Learn to edit one video of my own.

items.zh: 做完一件能拿出手的作品。
items.en: Finish one piece I can show people.

items.zh: 练到能完整弹一首曲子。
items.en: Play one song all the way through.

items.zh: 学会用 AI 把工作快一半。
items.en: Use AI to cut my work time in half.

items.zh: 戒掉一个偷走时间的习惯。
items.en: Drop one habit that steals my time.

items.zh: 在别人面前讲一次。
items.en: Speak in front of people once.

items.zh: 陪爸妈吃三十顿饭。
items.en: Thirty dinners with my parents.

items.zh: 带妈妈去做一次体检。
items.en: Take my mother for a checkup.

items.zh: 和爸爸单独出去一次。
items.en: One outing with just my father.

items.zh: 见一个很久没见的朋友。
items.en: See a friend I have not seen in years.

items.zh: 给朋友写一封手写的信。
items.en: Write a friend a letter by hand.

items.zh: 记住家里每个人的生日。
items.en: Remember every birthday in the family.

items.zh: 和伴侣过一个不谈工作的周末。
items.en: One weekend with my partner, no work talk.

items.zh: 陪孩子做一件他想做的事。
items.en: Do one thing my child wants to do.

items.zh: 和邻居说一次话。
items.en: Say a few words to a neighbour.

items.zh: 给很久没联系的人打一次电话。
items.en: Call someone I have not called in a long time.

items.zh: 连续七天在十一点前睡。
items.en: Seven nights asleep before eleven.

items.zh: 每周留一个晚上只给自己。
items.en: One evening a week that is only mine.

items.zh: 给情绪留一个出口。
items.en: Give my feelings somewhere to go.

items.zh: 一周散步三次。
items.en: Walk three times a week.

items.zh: 每天写三件小事。
items.en: Three small things, written down daily.

items.zh: 把手机放在另一个房间一小时。
items.en: Leave the phone in another room for an hour.

items.zh: 认真吃一顿早饭。
items.en: Eat one proper breakfast.

items.zh: 给自己买一束花。
items.en: Buy myself flowers.

items.zh: 做一次完整体检。
items.en: Get one full checkup.

items.zh: 允许自己什么都不做一天。
items.en: Allow one day of doing nothing.

items.zh: 三十岁前做一件完全属于自己的作品。
items.en: One piece entirely mine before thirty.

items.zh: 有一个能养活自己的副业。
items.en: A side income that can carry me.

items.zh: 搬到一个有阳台的城市。
items.en: Move to a city with a balcony.

items.zh: 用一年时间换一种活法。
items.en: One year to live differently.

items.zh: 有一间自己的小工作室。
items.en: A small studio of my own.

items.zh: 把身体练到能跑完十公里。
items.en: Train until I can run ten kilometres.

items.zh: 有几个能互相托底的朋友。
items.en: A few friends who will catch me.

items.zh: 做一件让爸妈骄傲的事。
items.en: One thing my parents can be proud of.

items.zh: 五年后不再为钱做不想做的事。
items.en: In five years, no more work I do only for money.

items.zh: 留下一本写给自己的记录。
items.en: Leave behind a record written to myself.

plans.en: Finish the resume tonight.

plans.zh: 出门前把行李清单勾完。
plans.en: Tick the packing list before leaving.
Book one checkup this week.
Clear the desk in one go.
Write down three wishes tonight.
Get to the sea this month.

plans.zh: 把手机相册按年份整理成三本。
plans.en: Sort my camera roll into three year albums.
Have one dinner with an old friend.
Eight glasses of water a day.
One line before sleep.
Six thousand steps a day.
Ten minutes of stretching daily.
Ten pages a day.
Log one expense a day.
Say one sentence to someone daily.
Lights off at half past ten.
Work out three times a week.

plans.zh: 每周留一个独处的晚上。
plans.en: One solo evening each week.

plans.zh: 每周给爸妈打一次电话。
plans.en: Call my parents once a week.
Fifteen minutes of review each week.

plans.zh: 每周做一道没做过的菜。
plans.en: Cook one new dish each week.
Tidy the room once a week.
Put money aside once a week.
Meet a friend once a week.

plans.zh: 每月存下收入的百分之二十。
plans.en: Save twenty percent of income monthly.
Finish one book a month.

plans.zh: 每月出门一次，离开熟悉的城区。
plans.en: Go somewhere outside my district once a month.

plans.zh: 每月给爸妈寄一次东西。
plans.en: Send my parents something every month.
Reconcile the accounts each month.
Ship one small piece a month.

plans.zh: 每月盘点一次身体信号。
plans.en: Check in on my body once a month.

plans.zh: 每月请自己吃一顿好的。
plans.en: Treat myself to one good meal a month.
One long trip a year.
One full checkup a year.
Learn one new skill a year.
Sort the year's photos once.
Write a letter to my future self each year.

plans.zh: 每年陪家人过一个完整的节日。
plans.en: Spend one full holiday with my family.
Finish one piece each year.

plans.zh: 每年回一次老家，看一次旧友。
plans.en: Go back home once a year, see an old friend.
